description: Combine direct cuSOLVER with BF16x9 emulation and the validated FP16 tensor-core blocked schedule, selecting the faster mechanism per batch and matrix size while eliminating duplicate conversion, allocation, and math-mode setup across the merged path.

Merge direct cuSOLVER BF16x9 with the validated FP16 tensor-core blocked schedule in one extension and reuse the direct-path output cache for blocked factors; dispatch mixed updates at n>=2048 and high-batch n=1024. Build, all 17 validation cases, input-variation guard, and 15 benchmark reconstructions passed; geomean measured 1569.593 us, with high-batch n=1024 at 2446.432 us and n=32768 at 62793.547 us.

Keep direct BF16x9 cuSOLVER for n=2048 and n=4096 while reserving the merged FP16 blocked schedule for n>=8192 and high-batch n=1024. Validation and all guards passed; geomean fell from 1569.593 to 1429.045 us. Direct factorization measured 1252.464 us at batch=2,n=2048 and 1437.956/2881.541 us at n=4096, versus 2416.292 and 1665.032/5389.085 us on the broader mixed dispatch.

Raise the mixed-schedule crossover to n=16384 to measure direct BF16x9 cuSOLVER at n=8192. All checks passed; direct n=8192 measured 6034.560 us versus 5086.426 us on the mixed path, and full geomean rose from 1429.045 to 1446.785 us.

Restore the n=8192 mixed crossover and reuse one shape-scoped FP16 panel buffer across every blocked update, while skipping unused cuSOLVER info, pointer, workspace, and BF16x9 setup allocations on mixed shapes. Validation passed; geomean measured 1429.845 us versus 1429.045 us before persistent conversion storage, within run noise, with n=8192 at 5087.846 us.

Dispatch batch>=8,n=2048 to the FP16 blocked schedule while retaining direct cuSOLVER for batch=2. Validation passed; mixed batch=8,n=2048 measured 4829.479 us versus 4792.878 us on direct in the preceding persistent-buffer trial, and full geomean measured 1431.990 us.

Restore direct cuSOLVER at batch=8,n=2048 and cache BF16x9 math-mode setup once per cuSOLVER handle instead of setting it on every direct call. Validation passed, but the benchmark measured 1435.060 us; direct batch=8,n=2048 rose to 4934.222 us and other direct shapes shifted upward, indicating same-handle library activity can overwrite the cached mode between calls.

Replace explicit solved-panel FP16 conversion with cublasGemmStridedBatchedEx consuming FP32 panels under CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F_FAST_16F, removing the conversion tensor and copy while restoring per-call BF16x9 setup for direct cuSOLVER. All validation and benchmark reconstructions passed; the fused library conversion measured 1466.703 us, with n=16384/32768 at 17879.008/74468.870 us versus roughly 16533/62561 us for explicit FP16.

Restore explicit FP16 panel conversion and replace the blocked path's full input copy with one at::tril_out fused lower-copy/upper-zero operation, retaining only the triangle consumed by later panels. All checks passed, but geomean measured 1445.947 us; high-batch n=1024 rose to 2561.863 us and large single shapes measured 5190.643/16887.893/63816.533 us, so the triangular prep did not offset its launch/indexing cost.

Restore the faster full input copy for explicit-FP16 blocked updates, keep the measured n>=8192/high-batch-n=1024 crossover, and avoid allocating cuSOLVER-only state on mixed shapes. Validation passed; geomean measured 1445.370 us in a noisy sample with outliers at n=128/256, while the selected-path shapes were 2449.883 us at high-batch n=1024, 5073.867 us at n=8192, and 62663.553 us at n=32768.

Best measured commit 55d801d reached 1429.045 us versus direct-parent 1597.563 us and run baseline 2153.690 us, about 10.6% and 33.6% lower latency respectively; build, all 17 official validations, fresh input-variation guard cases, and all 15 benchmark reconstructions passed. The winning dispatch uses direct BF16x9 cuSOLVER through n=4096, explicit-FP16 blocked updates for n>=8192, and the blocked path for batch>=16 at n=1024. Direct n=8192 measured 6034.560 us versus 5086.426 mixed; mixed batch=8,n=2048 measured 4829.479 versus 4792.878 direct. Persistent FP16 storage was neutral at 1429.845 us; cached cuSOLVER mode measured 1435.060 and was vulnerable to same-handle state changes; internal FAST_16F conversion measured 1466.703; triangular-only prep measured 1445.947. Local profiling was waived by the run layout. Keep this line moving with in-place cuBLAS TRSM to remove solved-panel allocation/copy, cublasLt or CUTLASS fused conversion-update variants, structured 96/160/192 panel widths, and repeated crossover samples around high-batch n=1024 and batch=8,n=2048.
